import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars = ax1.bar(df['brand'], df['price_usd'], color=[brand_colors[b] for b in df['brand']])
ax1.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price by Brand')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar, price in zip(bars, df['price_usd']):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 50, 
             f'${price:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=[brand_colors[brand]], label=brand, s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel", len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Max ISO (Scatter with size by megapixels)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['max_iso'], 
                       c=df['model_year'], s=df['megapixels']*5, 
                       cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO\n(size = megapixels, color = year)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Model Year')

# 5. Body Type Count (Horizontal bar)
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax5.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(body_counts)))
ax5.set_xlabel('Count')
ax5.set_ylabel('Body Type')
ax5.set_title('Camera Body Type Distribution')
for bar, count in zip(bars, body_counts.values):
    ax5.text(bar.get_width() + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             str(count), va='center', fontsize=10)

# 6. Timeline: Model Year vs Specs
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
ax6.plot(df['model_year'], df['megapixels'], 'o-', label='Megapixels', color='blue', markersize=8)
ax6_twin = ax6.twinx()
ax6_twin.plot(df['model_year'], df['max_iso']/1000, 's--', label='Max ISO (k)', color='red', markersize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax6.set_ylabel('Megapixels', color='blue')
ax6_twin.set_ylabel('Max ISO (thousands)', color='red')
ax6.set_title('Camera Specs Over Time')
ax6.legend(loc='upper left')
ax6_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
